title: 10 Mykonos Wedding Venues for a Cycladic Celebration
audience: Couples in their 30s interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences, AUD 150k+ budget
notes: NEW venue guide (not a refresh). Title '10 Mykonos Wedding Venues for a Cycladic Celebration'. Model: content/posts/crete-wedding-venues and content/posts/corfu-wedding-venues: every venue verified on its own official site (a live read, never search snippets alone); house rules not published written as 'Not published', listed on a booking checklist; no prices or fees. INCLUSION RULE: the venue's own official site says it hosts weddings. 'Cycladic' is framing only, written from each venue's own description where stated. Reuse and re-check live: Santa Marina and the Myconian Collection (content/posts/greece-wedding-venues/03-source-pack*.json, content/posts/greece-wedding-packages/03-source-pack*.json) and Grecotel Mykonos Lolita (Grecotel wedding page: private chapel 'with infinite views to the Aegean sea').

OVERLAP: SEO checks whether any site page (incl. /destinations/europe/greece) ranks for 'mykonos wedding venues' and variants (mykonos wedding, getting married in mykonos, mykonos wedding chapel, mykonos villa wedding, mykonos wedding packages). Link the Greece venues guide and Greece packages guide (drafts) both ways, the Greece hub, /expert-advice/greek-wedding-traditions once.

AUTHORITY RULE (content-system/brand/voice-guide.md 'Write with authority'): no research talk in the copy (what we could or couldn't find, trace or confirm; our sources or method; what the internet says; myths sections; 'you will often read'). Customs without a strong source are written as living practice in a confident voice ('Many couples...'), never with a meaning or origin stated as fact. 'Often told' at most once per post, never 'it is often told that'. No hedge stacking: cite a source once by link; date legal and travel facts once per section. Source gaps go in the run report only. No per-line source credits (never 'Britannica describes', 'the museum holds', 'the study records'). No myth-busting lines ('you will often read', 'confident dates').

Venue selection (brief sets 10 plus about 8 reserves across 4 batches): Agios Ioannis, Ornos, Agios Stefanos, Mykonos Town; Psarou, Platis Gialos, Paraga; Elia, Kalo Livadi; Agios Sostis, Ftelia, Houlakia; private villas and event venues. Unconfirmable candidates are swapped; do not pad to 10 (if fewer qualify, the title count changes and the person is told).

Each venue entry, from official pages only: location and setting; ceremony options (chapel, terrace, beach; civil, Orthodox or symbolic only as stated); capacity, rooms, exclusive use where published, else 'Not published'; one standout detail. One Advisor line in the whole article (comparison section), not per area.

Supporting sections (short, sourced): at-a-glance table (6 columns); how to compare like for like; choosing an area; getting there (Mykonos airport and port, official sources only); when to marry (HNMS averages for Mykonos, meltemi only as an official source states it, Smartraveller heat and wildfire); legal in brief (Embassy Athens and Smartraveller re-checked, as at November 2026, link the Greece guide's legal section).

Sources: venues' official sites and wedding pages, visitgreece.gr, the airport's official site, hnms.gr, Smartraveller, the Australian Embassy Athens. Never competitor wedding sites, directories, planner blogs, booking sites, review sites or Wikipedia.

Speed: Apify web-fetch and DataForSEO. Fact-check as 4 parallel batches (A: Agios Ioannis, Ornos, Agios Stefanos, Town incl. Santa Marina, fact_01+; B: Psarou, Platis Gialos, Paraga, fact_100+; C: Elia, Kalo Livadi, north incl. Myconian and Lolita, fact_200+; D: villas and event venues plus airport, weather, legal, fact_300+), 15 min HARD by the clock, no new reads after the limit, save after every 3 facts, scratch folders myk_a..myk_d; top-up myk_e (fact_400+) only if fewer than 10 qualify; never retry a declined call.
Images: placeholders only; every venue image licensed or from a venue press kit with permission; never AI for a venue, destination or wedding; competitor images reference-only.
Headings must not contain pasted keywords in brackets.

Do not use 'from first idea to the last dance' or 'last dance'; Advisor claims only from brand-facts.md; nothing on legal, church or religious paperwork; no transfer arrangements; no Wedded Privileges.
Person's standards: exactly 4 one-sentence Key takeaways; no prices or amounts; venue names allowed, no other vendor names; business details deferred; Australian English; no em dashes.
